arStrings.szText: Are you not aware? Azmodan and his vile brethren have invaded your world. I journeyed in secret after sensing his presence.
The High Heavens have forbidden any interference with Sanctuary...
For what is justice if not a touch of defiance? As for Azmodan, Belial, Duriel, and Andariel, they must be quelled before they consume the world itself.
The High Heavens will know if my power is solely gifted, though they won’t know if I use divine Light to sanctify the mantle that shields you.
You may use my blessing and this forge. Use it to imbue the power of heaven into your equipment.
